(the prompt's named fix: the right hind assembles at its 0.5 clock column); (b) servo(): the same expression at the hind-target site (the same commit f0efbba7 dropped phi_ there; the pre-forelimb bytes read tables_.at(phi_[...]) at all three sites -- without this site the reset repair is dragged back to the TD column during the settle and no hind lift can fire at its clock phase); (c) update_clock(): the right leg's per-tick increment drops the +0.5 (the doc's Section 5.1 law phi_leg=(t/T+off) mod 1 with the offset applied ONCE at init {0,0.5}, which reset() already does; the per-tick +0.5 aliased phi_[1] into two interleaved half-clocks, measurable in the old status phase columns). gait_unit.cpp: the F-G16 fore-load census (per-tick total fore reaction + max slip over [0,60), bound from the recipe), the F-G16 hind-reset census (tick-0 pair-min gaps vs the corrected derivation; right-hind tick-0 joint angles vs the 0.5 column), the F-G16 hind clock census (first hind liftoff tick/phase vs the 0.68 toe-off).

The vault table, entry phases {0,0.5}, fore clock (wave-15-repaired), IK solver, elbow ceiling, fore_share, and the trunk hand-off machinery are untouched.
